stem_en: A 58-year-old man presents with 40 minutes of crushing retrosternal chest pain. The ECG shows ST-segment elevation in leads II, III and aVF. Occlusion of which artery is most likely?
stem_ru: Мужчина 58 лет поступил с давящей загрудинной болью, продолжающейся 40 минут. На ЭКГ — подъём сегмента ST в отведениях II, III, aVF. Окклюзия какой артерии наиболее вероятна?
option_a_ru: Передняя межжелудочковая ветвь левой коронарной артерии
explanation_en: Leads II, III and aVF look at the inferior wall of the left ventricle. In most people (right-dominant circulation) the inferior wall is supplied by the right coronary artery, so inferior STEMI usually reflects RCA occlusion. The left circumflex is responsible in a minority of left-dominant patients. LAD occlusion causes anterior changes (V1–V4).
tutor_hint: Think of the leads as cameras: II, III and aVF all view the inferior wall. Ask which artery usually feeds that wall — in a right-dominant heart, that's the RCA. Also check V4R for right-ventricular involvement before giving nitrates.
key_terms: подъём сегмента ST = ST-segment elevation; загрудинная боль = retrosternal chest pain

stem_en: A haemodynamically stable 30-year-old woman has a regular narrow-complex tachycardia at 190/min. Vagal manoeuvres have failed. What is the most appropriate next drug?
stem_ru: У гемодинамически стабильной женщины 30 лет регулярная тахикардия с узкими комплексами QRS, ЧСС 190 в минуту. Вагусные пробы неэффективны. Какой препарат наиболее целесообразен?
explanation_en: Regular narrow-complex tachycardia in a stable patient is most often an AV-nodal re-entrant tachycardia. After vagal manoeuvres fail, a rapid IV bolus of adenosine transiently blocks the AV node and usually terminates it. Synchronised cardioversion is reserved for unstable patients; atropine would accelerate the rate.
tutor_hint: Key words: 'stable', 'regular', 'narrow'. That combination points to a re-entry circuit through the AV node, so the drug that briefly blocks the AV node is the logical next step. Instability would change the answer to electricity.
key_terms: вагусные пробы = vagal manoeuvres; тахикардия с узкими комплексами = narrow-complex tachycardia

stem_en: A pleural fluid sample is analysed. Which finding indicates that the effusion is an exudate according to Light's criteria?
stem_ru: Проведён анализ плевральной жидкости. Какой показатель свидетельствует об экссудате согласно критериям Лайта?
option_a_en: Pleural fluid / serum protein ratio of 0.3
option_a_ru: Отношение белка плевральной жидкости к белку сыворотки 0,3
option_b_en: Pleural fluid / serum protein ratio greater than 0.5
option_b_ru: Отношение белка плевральной жидкости к белку сыворотки более 0,5
option_c_en: Pleural fluid / serum LDH ratio of 0.4
option_c_ru: Отношение ЛДГ плевральной жидкости к ЛДГ сыворотки 0,4
option_d_en: Pleural LDH below two-thirds of the serum upper limit of normal
option_d_ru: ЛДГ плевральной жидкости менее 2/3 верхней границы нормы сыворотки
explanation_en: Light's criteria classify an effusion as an exudate if ANY of the following is true: pleural/serum protein > 0.5, pleural/serum LDH > 0.6, or pleural LDH > two-thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH. Options A, C and D all fall on the transudate side.
tutor_hint: Remember the three numbers: 0.5 (protein ratio), 0.6 (LDH ratio), 2/3 (LDH vs upper limit). Only one option crosses a threshold.
key_terms: плевральный выпот = pleural effusion; экссудат = exudate; транссудат = transudate

stem_en: A tall, thin 22-year-old man develops sudden right-sided pleuritic chest pain and breathlessness. On the right, breath sounds are absent and percussion is hyperresonant. What is the most likely diagnosis?
stem_ru: У высокого худощавого мужчины 22 лет внезапно возникли боль в правой половине грудной клетки, усиливающаяся при дыхании, и одышка. Справа дыхание не проводится, перкуторно — коробочный звук. Наиболее вероятный диагноз?
explanation_en: Primary spontaneous pneumothorax typically affects tall, thin young men without lung disease. Air in the pleural space gives absent breath sounds with a hyperresonant percussion note. Effusion and consolidation are dull to percussion.
tutor_hint: Percussion is the discriminator: dull = fluid or consolidation; hyperresonant = air. Combine that with the classic patient profile.
key_terms: пневмоторакс = pneumothorax; коробочный звук = hyperresonant percussion note

stem_en: A 64-year-old man has painless progressive jaundice, weight loss and a palpable, non-tender gallbladder. Which diagnosis is most likely?
stem_ru: У мужчины 64 лет безболевая нарастающая желтуха, снижение массы тела, пальпируется увеличенный безболезненный желчный пузырь. Наиболее вероятный диагноз?
option_b_en: Carcinoma of the head of the pancreas
explanation_en: Courvoisier's law: a palpable, non-tender gallbladder with painless jaundice is unlikely to be due to gallstones and suggests malignant obstruction of the distal common bile duct, classically carcinoma of the pancreatic head. Gallstone disease tends to cause a fibrosed, non-distensible gallbladder and painful episodes.
tutor_hint: Painless + palpable gallbladder + weight loss is a red-flag triad. Ask yourself why stones rarely produce a distended gallbladder.
key_terms: симптом Курвуазье = Courvoisier's sign; механическая желтуха = obstructive jaundice

stem_en: A patient with a duodenal ulcer tests positive for Helicobacter pylori. In a region with low clarithromycin resistance, which first-line regimen is appropriate?
stem_ru: У пациента с язвой двенадцатиперстной кишки выявлен Helicobacter pylori. В регионе с низкой резистентностью к кларитромицину какая схема первой линии целесообразна?
option_a_en: Proton pump inhibitor alone for 8 weeks
explanation_en: Where clarithromycin resistance is low, standard triple therapy (PPI + clarithromycin + amoxicillin) for 14 days is an accepted first-line regimen; bismuth quadruple therapy is the usual alternative. Monotherapy does not eradicate H. pylori. Always follow current national guidelines.
tutor_hint: Eradication needs acid suppression plus two antibiotics. Single agents fail because of resistance and low gastric drug activity.
key_terms: эрадикация = eradication; ингибитор протонной помпы (ИПП) = proton pump inhibitor (PPI)

stem_en: A 19-year-old with type 1 diabetes presents with vomiting, Kussmaul breathing, glucose 28 mmol/L and pH 7.1. What is the most important first step in management?
stem_ru: Пациент 19 лет с сахарным диабетом 1 типа поступил с рвотой, дыханием Куссмауля, глюкозой 28 ммоль/л и pH 7,1. Какое первоочередное мероприятие наиболее важно?
explanation_en: Patients in DKA are severely volume-depleted. The first priority is IV isotonic fluid (0.9% NaCl), followed by a fixed-rate IV insulin infusion and careful potassium replacement. Bicarbonate is not routinely recommended; subcutaneous long-acting insulin alone is inadequate in the acute phase.
tutor_hint: Fluids first, then insulin, and watch potassium closely. Insulin drives potassium into cells, so check K⁺ before and during insulin therapy.
key_terms: диабетический кетоацидоз = diabetic ketoacidosis; дыхание Куссмауля = Kussmaul breathing

stem_en: Which laboratory pattern is typical of primary hypothyroidism?
stem_ru: Какие лабораторные показатели характерны для первичного гипотиреоза?
option_d_ru: ТТГ в норме, свободный T4 повышен
explanation_en: In primary hypothyroidism the thyroid itself fails, so free T4 falls and the pituitary responds by increasing TSH. Low TSH with low T4 suggests secondary (central) hypothyroidism.
tutor_hint: Follow the feedback loop: if the gland fails, the pituitary 'shouts louder' — TSH rises.
key_terms: гипотиреоз = hypothyroidism; тиреотропный гормон (ТТГ) = thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH)

stem_en: Ten days after a tick bite in a forested region, a patient develops an expanding annular red rash with central clearing. Which treatment is most appropriate for an adult?
stem_ru: Через 10 дней после укуса клеща в лесной зоне у пациента появилась расширяющаяся кольцевидная эритема с просветлением в центре. Какое лечение наиболее целесообразно у взрослого?
explanation_en: An expanding annular rash with central clearing after a tick bite is erythema migrans, the hallmark of early Lyme borreliosis. Doxycycline is first-line for adults; amoxicillin is an alternative (e.g. in pregnancy). Antivirals, antifungals and metronidazole have no role.
tutor_hint: Erythema migrans is a clinical diagnosis — serology is often negative this early. Treat the spirochaete.
key_terms: мигрирующая эритема = erythema migrans; иксодовый клещевой боррелиоз = Lyme borreliosis

stem_en: A traveller returning from sub-Saharan Africa has high fever and confusion. A thin blood film shows numerous ring forms. Which species is most likely?
stem_ru: У путешественника, вернувшегося из Африки южнее Сахары, высокая лихорадка и спутанность сознания. В тонком мазке крови — многочисленные кольцевидные формы. Какой вид возбудителя наиболее вероятен?
explanation_en: Plasmodium falciparum causes severe malaria, including cerebral malaria (confusion, coma). It produces high parasitaemia with multiple ring forms per red cell and is the dominant species in sub-Saharan Africa. It is a medical emergency.
tutor_hint: Confusion + travel to sub-Saharan Africa + many rings = treat as severe falciparum malaria until proven otherwise.
key_terms: тропическая малярия = falciparum malaria; тонкий мазок крови = thin blood film

stem_en: A 45-year-old woman reports a sudden, severe 'worst-ever' headache followed by vomiting and neck stiffness. What is the first investigation?
stem_ru: Женщина 45 лет жалуется на внезапную интенсивную головную боль («самую сильную в жизни»), рвоту и ригидность затылочных мышц. Какое исследование проводится в первую очередь?
explanation_en: A sudden 'thunderclap' headache suggests subarachnoid haemorrhage. Non-contrast CT is the first investigation and is most sensitive in the first hours. If CT is negative but suspicion remains, lumbar puncture is performed later (looking for xanthochromia).
tutor_hint: Imaging comes before LP: CT first, and LP only if CT is negative and the story is convincing.
key_terms: субарахноидальное кровоизлияние = subarachnoid haemorrhage; ригидность затылочных мышц = neck stiffness

stem_en: A right-handed man suddenly develops right-sided weakness affecting the face and arm more than the leg, with non-fluent speech but preserved comprehension. Which vascular territory is affected?
stem_ru: У мужчины-правши внезапно развилась слабость в правых конечностях (рука и лицо больше, чем нога), речь прерывистая, с трудом подбирает слова, понимание обращённой речи сохранено. Какой сосудистый бассейн поражён?
explanation_en: Face and arm weakness greater than leg weakness indicates the middle cerebral artery territory. Expressive (Broca's) aphasia means the dominant hemisphere is involved — the left in nearly all right-handed people. Contralateral signs place the lesion in the left MCA.
tutor_hint: Two steps: (1) which side? opposite to the weakness; (2) which artery? face + arm > leg is MCA, leg > arm is ACA.
key_terms: моторная афазия = expressive (Broca's) aphasia; гемипарез = hemiparesis

stem_en: A woman at 36 weeks' gestation has blood pressure 170/112 mmHg, proteinuria and a severe headache. Which drug is used to prevent eclamptic seizures?
stem_ru: У беременной на сроке 36 недель АД 170/112 мм рт. ст., протеинурия и сильная головная боль. Какой препарат применяется для профилактики судорог при эклампсии?
explanation_en: Magnesium sulfate is the drug of choice for preventing and treating eclamptic seizures. Monitor reflexes, respiratory rate and urine output for toxicity; calcium gluconate is the antidote.
tutor_hint: Know the toxicity checks for magnesium: loss of deep tendon reflexes comes before respiratory depression.

stem_en: What is the most common cause of primary postpartum haemorrhage?
stem_ru: Какова наиболее частая причина раннего послеродового кровотечения?
explanation_en: Uterine atony accounts for the large majority of primary postpartum haemorrhage. The 'four Ts' — Tone, Trauma, Tissue, Thrombin — structure the differential, with Tone the most common.
tutor_hint: Use the four Ts: Tone, Trauma, Tissue, Thrombin — in that order of frequency.
key_terms: послеродовое кровотечение = postpartum haemorrhage; атония матки = uterine atony

stem_en: A 2-year-old has a low-grade fever, a barking cough and inspiratory stridor that is worse at night. What is the most likely diagnosis?
stem_ru: У ребёнка 2 лет субфебрильная температура, «лающий» кашель и инспираторный стридор, усиливающийся ночью. Наиболее вероятный диагноз?
explanation_en: Croup (acute laryngotracheitis), usually caused by parainfluenza virus, presents in children aged roughly 6 months to 3 years with a barking cough, hoarseness and inspiratory stridor, often worse at night. Epiglottitis presents with high fever, drooling and a toxic appearance, usually without a barking cough.
tutor_hint: The 'bark' is the clue. A drooling, toxic child sitting forward should make you think epiglottitis instead.
key_terms: инспираторный стридор = inspiratory stridor; «лающий» кашель = barking cough

stem_en: What is the most common cause of acute bronchiolitis in infants?
stem_ru: Какой возбудитель является наиболее частой причиной острого бронхиолита у детей первого года жизни?
explanation_en: Respiratory syncytial virus is the most common cause of bronchiolitis in infants, with seasonal epidemics. Management is mainly supportive (oxygen, feeding support).
tutor_hint: Bronchiolitis in an infant during winter epidemics: think RSV first.

stem_en: In a patient with suspected appendicitis, pressure in the left iliac fossa causes pain in the right iliac fossa. What is this sign called?
stem_ru: У пациента с подозрением на аппендицит надавливание в левой подвздошной области вызывает боль в правой подвздошной области. Как называется этот симптом?
explanation_en: Rovsing's sign is pain in the right iliac fossa when the left iliac fossa is pressed, and is associated with appendicitis. Murphy's sign relates to cholecystitis, Courvoisier's sign to a distended gallbladder in malignant obstruction, and Kehr's sign is referred left shoulder pain (e.g. splenic rupture).
tutor_hint: Eponymous signs are high-yield for terminology: learn each one with its Russian name and the organ it points to.
key_terms: подвздошная область = iliac fossa; симптом Ровзинга = Rovsing's sign

stem_en: A 40-year-old woman has right upper quadrant pain and fever. During deep palpation under the right costal margin she stops inspiring because of pain. Which diagnosis does this sign suggest?
stem_ru: У женщины 40 лет боль в правом подреберье и лихорадка. При глубокой пальпации под правой рёберной дугой она прерывает вдох из-за боли. На какой диагноз указывает этот симптом?
explanation_en: Murphy's sign — inspiratory arrest during palpation under the right costal margin — suggests acute cholecystitis. Fever and RUQ pain support the diagnosis; ultrasound is the first-line imaging.
tutor_hint: Inspiratory arrest = the inflamed gallbladder moves down onto the examining hand.
key_terms: правое подреберье = right upper quadrant; симптом Мерфи = Murphy's sign
